style.presentationRules: shackles rendered clean and polished, centered on minimal geometric display platforms; stable slightly-low front 3/4 hero angle across product shots; consistent product scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: white marble slab podiums, matte white geometric platforms (diamond slab, cylinder) and clean seamless studio floors
